name: Vulpter
description: Vulpter was a planet located in the galaxy's Deep Core that was the homeworld of the Vulptereen podracer Dud Bolt. The KX-series security droid K-2SO was constructed on Vulpter, as were many of the Galactic Empire's probe droids.
lead_paragraphs: Vulpter was a planet located in the galaxy's Deep Core that was the homeworld of the Vulptereen podracer Dud Bolt. The KX-series security droid K-2SO was constructed on Vulpter, as were many of the Galactic Empire's probe droids.
